### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **repo:** restore six stable apps alongside Prezzi Benzina and guard release inventory ([e3d8b84](https://github.com/Edoardo9708/LegheFC-Morphe-Patches/commit/e3d8b84c3fcc3164b7ab03db3f07efd2d13bb1ae))

patches.name: DNS Changer - Force Pro test D2
patches.description: Test only: forces z() to return true and logs the forced value; does not change purchases.

patches.name: Flowx - Test stato Gold locale
patches.description: Inserisce dati dimostrativi Gold nella cache locale dell'app per verificarne il comportamento; non modifica l'abbonamento lato server.

patches.name: Fonometro - Remove ads
patches.description: Removes banner and interstitial ads without modifying Premium status, licenses, or in-app purchases.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Avvio e nome 3 campo
patches.description: Corregge l'avvio dell'app e la rinomina in 3 campo.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Sblocca formazione suggerita e comparatore
patches.description: Formazione suggerita e confronto fra giocatori.

patches.name: Leghe FC - Sblocca percentuali
patches.description: Mostra le percentuali utili per scegliere chi schierare.

patches.name: Prezzi Benzina - Remove ads A1
patches.description: Test: disables banner and interstitial ads without changing Premium, licenses or in-app purchases.

patches.name: Prezzi Benzina - microG token routing F13
patches.description: Local test: route only Maps ApiTokenService to the existing app.revanced.android.gms and declare the original public certificate digest. No Frida; use alone, not with F5-F12.
